cases.physical_pad_current_definition: Coherent complex integral of peak J over each pad first; sqrt(sum_f|I_pad,f|^2/2) afterwards; native density sign retained
cases.common_GND_return_definition: Coherent sum of physical pad2+pad3 current at each frequency before RMS; not sum of individual RMS magnitudes
cases.numerical_status: contact scalar readback only; prior convergence/held gates unchanged

definitions.density_storage: little-endian complex128(2,npatches); basis channel major, density[channel*npatches+patch]
definitions.phasor: peak,+jomega_t; source basis0.5Vpeak through50ohm; square sine coefficients -j*a
definitions.contact_impedance: Area-specific complex Z_A in ohm*m2 from pinned config; no additional area division or Rs subtraction
definitions.contact_fraction: physical contact patch area divided by native full XY face h^2; no SC thickness or tissue-volume denominator
definitions.percentile: frozen nearest sequential cumulative area: first value reaching0.95*sequential_prefix[-1], no interpolation
definitions.max_patch_ties: first native patch in stored order; top8 stable native ordering

limitations: Patch-normal contact J is not full-vector skin J or deep TIS modulation
Small contact area fractions and hotspot coincidence describe numerical contact representation; they do not prove an unphysical artifact
No geometric edge/corner distance is inferred for arbitrary concave/elliptical shapes
Nearest area-CDF P95 retains one-patch rank sensitivity at cumulative-area ties
PBS interface remains an uncertain skin-contact model; no new Rs subtraction, area correction or experiment validation
Prior SC/XY/bulk/edge/contact gates remain unchanged; no candidate adoption or safety/physiology claim
